headline: Wrong Callout
question: Garfield or O'Malley?
caption:
Payton Talbott called out Andrew Garfield by mistake after his UFC 332 win. 🕷️
Garfield or O'Malley? 👇

Fresh off a first-round TKO of former champ Deiveson Figueiredo in Salt Lake City, Talbott grabbed the mic with Joe Rogan and went straight for his next target: "Andrew Garfield, I mean, Sean O'Malley, you can't run forever." He corrected himself right away, but the Spider-Man actor got called out first. UFC 332 news and UFC bantamweight news.

Who would you rather see Talbott fight?
